noun.definition: A word or concept of great significance.
noun.example: The keyword in the report is 'efficiency'.

noun.definition: A word used in an information retrieval system to indicate the content of a document.
noun.example: To find the article, enter a few keywords into the search engine.

verb.definition: To set or provide with keywords.
verb.example: The website was keyworded to improve its search engine ranking.

usage_examples: Digital marketing relies heavily on choosing the right keywords.
Identify the keywords in the text to summarize it effectively.
